description: Notice Advisory to Galileo Users are the official notices that the European GNSS Service Centre issues about any activity or event in the Galileo system that affects the signal in space or the performance of the Open Service, the High Accuracy Service and Open Service Navigation Message Authentication against their service definition documents. Planned notices announce manoeuvres, station keeping, satellite relocations and outages such as on-board clock switches in advance, with start and end times, while unplanned ones report events afterwards, such as unavailable until further notice or short outages already recovered, and further types cover extensions, cancellations, decommissioning, extended operation mode, first usability and return to service, with the clock type in use. Coverage is the whole Galileo constellation, with lists of active and archived notices. Format and access: free web notices following published templates; a bulk download was not checked. Licence: GSC website terms, not read. Caveats: the archive depth and machine-readable access were not confirmed, and the notices describe events, not measured accuracy. It gives the outage history that resilience and cascading failure studies of GNSS-dependent infrastructure need. Related catalogue records are the Galileo quarterly performance reports and the Galileo satellite metadata.
